title: Jesus is the bread of life
description: After the miracle of the loaves, Jesus teaches in the synagogue at Capernaum and says that he is the true bread from heaven that gives eternal life. The people refer to the manna in the wilderness, but Jesus says that he himself is the bread of life. The Jews grumble because they know his family, and when he speaks about eating his body and drinking his blood, it causes controversy among the listeners.
